steps.content: It's not an intense battle, but it's enough to awaken the madness within her. Hecate is supported by Samuel, but she can barely hear him. All she sees is that detestable symbol of Rustfire.

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Give it back... Give Syndicate back...
The girl stares blankly at the frenzied Corruptors, then glances at the distorted Black Ring in the distance. The conflicting feelings inside her gradually fade, replaced by a more familiar emotion.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I... I know this feeling...

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Are you trying to take our home again? To hurt our leader again?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hatred... Anger... Failure... Disappointment...

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: The power is ours. More... more...!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You too... That man, and that monster too...

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Give Syndicate back!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Me too...

Someone once told her to value her own feelings. Hecate didn't know what it meant to have her own feelings. Now, for the first time, it is tangible to her. She must face it, acknowledge it, and name it.

steps.speaker: Manic Rustfire Member
steps.content: Die, DisCity intruders!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm just like you...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I... hate you too...
Beneath the Black Ring, Mania forces her to acknowledge her first emotion. Its name is hatred.

Corruptors swarm toward her like a tide, but she feels no fear now. The shared emotion is assimilating the two sides. This hatred is about to take over her entire being, summoning her to fuse with the Black Ring, to return to the origin with her kind...

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Hecate! Hecate, don't let it pull you in!
[Scene Change] The hero comes to the rescue
The monsters and chaotic illusions are suddenly severed by rays of white light, and a figure stands in front of them.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...A Sinner from the Underground...

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: No, you're Whitestone's...
The woman has a familiar aura about her that makes Hecate shiver all over. It reminds her of a group of enemies.
[Scene change] Parma, the man in the raincoat, the rune puppet
No, it's more than that. Another scene emerges in her head, with another person with a completely different air...
[Flashback CH6]

steps.speaker: Female Stranger
steps.content: No need to chase after me so eagerly now, take care of yourself first, our lovely Chief. Your path will not be easy from now on.

steps.speaker: Female Stranger
steps.content: ...I'll see you around.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You're the one who took Zoya away, aren't you... Are you the person we're looking for?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Will you save Chief?
The woman before her doesn't respond. Instead, she takes out a strange object and hands it to Hecate.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...Take this. Leave the rest to me.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hurry, just go. Go!
The woman turns her back to them, drawing her long sword to face the monsters, radiating a powerful energy. But...

Somehow her voice no longer sounds as carefree as before but is filled with repressed tension and fear. Like a virus, the emotion infects Hecate and sharpens her senses. She picks up on an ominous sensation...
She feels the presence of an Undergrounder somewhere in this maze, different from any enemy from the Underground they've encountered before.

It's a viscous, deep, maniacal, frightening, yet fascinating presence. It's vast and unknown, but Hecate also senses a hint of familiarity, as if it bears some resemblance to someone she knows very well.
Hecate wants to continue exploring, but her consciousness is fading away, her vision dimming.
